In this work we develop and evaluate an NLG-chatbot that generates insights explanation by combining graphics and text.
datasets: Simulated diet diary (2 weeks of logged meals)
outputs: Textual explanations of dietary insights combined with visualisations

quote: We run a human evaluation in which we compare our chatbot with traditional diet apps. Participants were assigned to either our chatbot or an app, and used it to take a 10-point quiz concerning the extraction of insights from a simulated food diary. At the end, participants expressed a feedback on the assigned tool.
To assess the effectiveness of this approach, we run a human evaluation in which we compare our chatbot with traditional diet apps.
We gather our test population (workers) through crowd-sourcing on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
guideline: A 10-question quiz on diet analysis tasks and Likert-5 scale ratings for tool characteristics such as usefulness and speed.

Participants used the assigned tool to answer a 10‑point quiz about diet insights and then rated the tool on several Likert‑5 scale questions (e.g., usefulness for finding diet problems, speed of use).

Each worker took the quiz and was asked to answer the questions to the best of their knowledge by using the tool. We ask each worker to rate the tool under different characteristics (see Figure ) through Likert-5 scale.
